spec.name: Halloween Forgetful Baker Ghost
spec.description: A pale lavender sheet ghost with a floppy white baker's hat, flour-smudged cheeks and an orange bow tie. Connected, axis-aligned static geometry preserves open gaps between the hanging sheet tips. Fits x/z 0–16 and y 0–24; includes a static six-bone armor rig.

prompt: Playful pale lavender sheet ghost in a floppy white bakers hat with flour smudges and orange bow tie. Connected static cuboid model x,z0..16 y0..24. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
